prov.text: The Company’s allowance for credit losses on loans is established through charges to earnings in the form of a provision for credit losses. The allowance is increased by provisions charged to operations and recoveries of amounts previously charged off and is reduced by recovery of provisions and loans charged off. Management continuously evaluates the adequacy of the allowance for credit losses. In evaluating the adequacy of the allowance, management considers the following: the growth, composition and industry diversification of the portfolio; historical loan loss experience; current delinquency levels; adverse situations that may affect a borrower’s ability to repay; estimated value of any underlying collateral; prevailing economic conditions; and other relevant factors.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonint.text:
Noninterest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by $1.1 million compared to the same period in 2025. Salaries and benefits, the largest component of noninterest expense, increased by $259,000 due to higher compensation and benefit costs during the three months ended September 30, 2026. Expense associated with market adjustments on SERP accounts increased by $446,000 compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025. Marketing and donations expense increased by $129,000 during the same period, primarily due to higher charitable contributions and other community support efforts.

Total other noninterest expense increased by $107,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025. The table below reflects the composition of other noninterest expense for the referenced periods.

net.text: Uwharrie Capital Corp reported net income of $2.9 million for both three-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. Net income available to common shareholders was $2.7 million, or $0.37 per common share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. Net income available to common shareholders is net income less dividends on the aforementioned noncontrolling interest.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $10.2 million, a $325,000 increase from the $9.9 million reported for the comparative period in 2025. During the third quarter of 2026, the average yield on our interest-earning assets decreased by 9 basis points to 5.10% from the same period in 2025, and the average rate we paid for our interest-bearing liabilities decreased 7 basis points to 2.25%. These changes resulted in an interest rate spread of 2.86% as of both September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025. The Company’s net interest margin was 3.48% and 3.50% for the comparable periods in 2026 and 2025, respectively. Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
The Company places significant emphasis on diversification of revenue sources rather than relying solely upon interest income. Total noninterest income increased by $155,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025. Income associated with market adjustments on SERP accounts increased by $446,000 and growth in assets under management (“AUM”) within the wealth management division contributed a $120,000 increase in other service fees and commissions. These increases offset the decline in mortgage banking income resulting from higher mortgage interest rates, which reduced mortgage origination and refinancing activity during the third quarter of 2026. Future mortgage banking income could be adversely affected if mortgage origination and refinancing volumes remain constrained by the higher interest rate environment.
